capabilities: Show linked references as whole blocks with children and breadcrumbs
Edit reference blocks in place and write them back to the note
Fold child blocks Logseq-style with configurable depth
Filter references by the pages, tags or notes they mention
List unlinked mentions of the note's name or aliases with a Link button
extras: Warns that running it alongside the core Backlinks plugin produces duplicate link lists, and explains how to close the core tab or disable its in-document backlink option.
intentEvidence: Started as a fork of Roam Backlinks by MatsuriMW.
problem: Obsidian's backlinks pane shows only a line of plain text around each link, without the surrounding block, its children, or the path of parent bullets.

relations.evidence: Started as a fork of Roam Backlinks by MatsuriMW.
Linked references the way Logseq shows them, in Obsidian.

summary: Linked-references viewer that shows each backlink as a whole block with children, breadcrumbs and in-place editing, under notes and in a sidebar view.
